reviews.text: Excellent doctors, courteous and professional staff..

I had to bring my princess Matilda in tonight to the ER at VCA Knowles sunset. All the ladies we came into contact with were just incredible. From Cheryl and Leah at the front desk to Olga and Dr Zepeda in the back they were all extremely accommodating and put me at ease. My dog is my best friend and these ladies treated me and her like family. I feel extremely lucky and grateful to them all! Thank you for being such selfless and amazing women! I can’t put into words how grateful I truly am! Thank you!

I had a great visit with my puppy Barney this past weekend everyone we dealt with was amazing. The young lady whom assisted us Hilary was a true delight. She was extremely empathetic with us and made sure we were taken care of! Dr Santos and Olga were incredible and put us at ease and took amazing care of our baby! We will definitely be back and will make snapper creek our go to Vet office!

My experience at this clinic with Dr. Santos and his nurse was a perfect 10. The team has the necessary knowledge to determine an animal's condition. Never in my entire medical history have I taken my dog ​​there with such clarity, professionalism, and humility. It's impressive to see doctors and nurses with such dedication. I'm very proud to have taken my dog ​​there and to leave with the knowledge needed to take action. Thank you so much! My recommendation is to keep in mind when you have a staff of such a high professional level. Thank you so much!

Despite the sadness I feel for having lost my Susi, I must acknowledge that all the staff who work there are spectacular, especially Dr. Perez. She is a wonderful person, very compassionate, and loves her profession. I know my Susi couldn't have been in better hands. God bless them all and continue to guide them in their difficult task of healing our furry friends.

All they care is about money. No consideration or hearth for what they do. The two teenagers they have in the front desk are rude and entitled, and just there for the paycheck. I do not recommend this place if you care about the animals

Thank you so much for the support Keith! We are thrilled that you had a positive experience with us. We’re always looking for ways to keep our clients (and their pets!) happy, so if you have a moment, we’d love to hear more about your visit. Feel free to send us a quick message at VCAcontactus@vca.com!
Prices for vaccines are outrageous, as are wait times. Go anywhere else.

Great staff ❤️ Adriana and Dr. Perez were amazing with our dog Maverick. Maverick normally gets very nervous at the vet, but he was very calm and allowed them to examine him. Thank you for your patience.

Very long wait times, but I always forget about that by the time I meet with the doctors and staff, due to how caring and professional they are. I’ve been bringing my two cats here for a couple years, and now I’ve been bringing my new rescue pup. While the prices are a bit steep, they line up with area and franchise vet norms - it’s not a fault of this business itself. Each vet I’ve seen has been so gentle, with great bedside manner; they listen, and they exemplify their care for our pets through their approaches.

They produced their findings.  I couldnt afford it all. Provided me the best option for my dog to continue living and I will come back for the procedures pending but where they outshine is helping me send their prescription referral to chewy for delivery approval. I truly appreciate this as I ran out of medicine [vetmedin] and my dogs my life but also because im going thru a hard time with my son and new home placement and they acted quickly to surpass the delay in approval times to then wait for the package.

Thank you !!!!!

Also download the app. Amazing tool

Unfortunately, I can’t give the same raving reviews that other reviewers have left regarding this VCA’s “professionalism”. I had a scheduled surgery for my cat, was told I would be able to drop him off in the morning, and proceeded to wait for over an hour just for a kennel to become available. Any time I asked for clarification on when my cat would be taken in for surgery or when he would be picked up, the receptionists would tell me “it depends”.
I’m already here for an incredibly stressful situation and am being left completely in the dark about what is going to happen to my pet that day.

I am now writing this review waiting for him to be ready to go home (and have been waiting for 40 minutes already) after calling before coming to ask if he was ready to be picked up and was told he was.

I understand this is an emergency hospital, but if you have scheduled surgeries, they should absolutely be honored and planned for ahead of time. Extremely stressful and frustrating experience. I will not be returning to this location.

I am extremely thankful to the whole team at VCA especially Dr. Betancourt and our nurse Melany. I took my baby Matilda in for a sever ear infection to VCA Knowles snapper creek location. Dr. Betancourt and Melany made the process easy and had incredible bed side manor. They took amazing care of my baby and got her back to her normal goofy self. I could not be more thankful to the entire team!

Dr. Betancourt along with all the techs were just fantastic, very patient, attentive and took their time to makes us feel comfortable and well cared for. Definitely 5 stars highly recommend, special thanks to Gaby for being so patient with my golden retriever Lychee Martini.
The best doctors in Miami, the veterinary technicians are very loving and skilled, the only downside is the very high prices

We are so happy with the care our cat receives at this hospital. They provide top-notch care and keep our kitten healthy. They give the animals so much love and care, and I wholeheartedly recommend them.

We cannot thank the team enough for the incredible care they provided for our dog, Nallie.

Nallie was admitted with pancreatitis and was also showing signs of developing pyometra. She required hospitalization, and thanks to the dedication, expertise, and compassion of the veterinary team, she recovered beautifully. Just one week after recovering from pancreatitis, she was spayed, and the entire process went smoothly.

Since then, we have gotten our happy, energetic dog back. In fact, it almost feels like our 10-year-old has become a puppy again! Seeing her playful, bright, and full of life has been the greatest gift, and we are so grateful to everyone who helped make that possible.

Throughout every step of Nallie’s treatment, the team was professional, knowledgeable, caring, and always took the time to keep us informed. We felt completely confident that she was receiving the very best care.

Thank you for giving Nallie a second chance to feel like herself again. We highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

Main doctor was extremely rude, lacked empathy, had horrible patient care, and would not recommend. Rest of staff was kind but I can’t emphasize it enough, main doctor was insufferable, does not have the right personality nor characteristics to be any type of doctor, went as far as to be petty and insult me and my family.

So terrible,  our dog is suffering so we went to put her down the male vet was so rude we our dog is 11 years old can’t walk can’t eat without throwing up no longer controls her bowls but no those arnt reason to put her out of her suffering . The vet said “we wanted to put her down” that he “was going to do free blood work but now I’m not “ because we said he was not being compassionate and being condescending. Make that make sense.

This is the worst veterinarian in the Kendall area, do not take your pets. I took my dog & cat because I did not know any better and they would always overcharge me & they wouldn’t treat them optimally or give them proper treatment. Very disrespectful front desk staff. Stay away from this vet. Better off trying VCA South dade or MVS.

Thank you for the sweet feedback Adriana! 💛🐾 Caring for pets and the people who love them is why we're here, and we're so glad that came through during your visit. If you every wanted to share more about your experience, feel free to reach out to our team at VCAcontactus@vca.com. 🥰 …
No other words can describe how incredible this place and thier staff are!!! Thank you!

My husband goes to see his mother who has dementia on a daily basis. This morning he arrived to find the 13 year old beagle in a puddle of blood coming from his anus. Prince has been lethargic, shaking in pain, and incontinent for 1 week. They ran tests $1600. We explained that the dog is in a home where he can't get the care needed as his owner is in hospice. They told my husband they don't euthanize but that he needed more tests, for which the cost was unknown. I went online to verify and found that they offer euthanasia and cremation. My husband and I are very disappointed with this clinic as we can't trust their intentions. I was shocked to learn that he is indeed in the end of life stage and the neighboring hospital agreed to euthanize him as he has no quality of life. Please be informed that Knowles is not kind, they only want to increase the amount of your bills. Stay clear of this establishment, read the reviews and get a second opinion if you don't feel right about the situation. It was today that I realized, that when my Welsh terrier went in with a collapsed trachea, they encouraged us to approve a $5000 surgery. The next day, my dog of 14 years had to be taken off a ventilator because their surgery failed. Today, i tealized they probably deceived me. I am at a loss that this establishment has been there for decades and this is happening under our noses. Thank you for your attention to this matter.
My Waffo received excellent medical care from very kind and professional people. Thank you for your help.

Surgery was good . We called today as we noticed 2 stiches left. They said they were going to call; this was not relayed TO US by the way. After he was released ( Tech was like tougher to see with his brindle coat. (Alarm bell!)NOT a dam thing about we left 2 stiches! And we were going to call you for a Wednesday appointment..  A MISS communication they proceeded.  Today is Sunday so we took him and took them out today. AT a minimum expect them to have stiches counted! ONE would think ALL major  surgeries all gauze 🔧 🔨 are counted. They  Looked at our faces and said yea that was on purpose because those needed more time. Im pissed as you see. 4,000 dollars and they were going to call us Monday or Tuesday, for a Wednesday appointment to take out the other 2. And so we left with his head wrap by the time we got home thing was falling off .
Amazing group of people and the best care for your dogs.

Last night was a rough night for our family and our new puppy. You never expect to have to take your new puppy to a ER and last night we had to. The ladies at the front desk answered all our questions and instantly put us at ease. They were able to get us right in. The entire staff had excellent demeanor and were just so kind. We are extremely grateful to all of them for showing us so much compassion and patience! Thank you again to the entire team! We will definitely be back to see you all hopefully not in a ER situation!

Longer than hour waits just to visit your hospitalized pet and they don’t look busy they’re conversating in the front about some drama from other coworkers. Have to keep reminding them of the same thing or following up because they won’t remember or follow up with you about your SICK pet. The front desk gives you misinformation. Check before you tell me something. The doctors were good so far. The experience overall though messy. if my experience changes i will update my review.
Service here is always the best.

I’ve had a great experience with the team at VCA Knowles. The staff has always been professional, compassionate, and genuinely caring with my dogs. One of my dogs went in with a serious emergency and the doctors and team handled everything quickly and confidently which made a stressful situation a lot easier on our family. Thank you again to the entire team for the excellent care.

Hey there, thank you so much for your support Alex! We truly appreciate it! 💙🐾 If you’d ever like to share more about your experience, we’d love to hear from you. Feel free to email us anytime at VCAcontactus@vca.com! …

I cannot recommend Knowles Animal Clinic in Sunset enough! They are always punctual, attentive, and have been there for me every time I’ve had an emergency with my dog. The entire team truly treats Rocky with so much love and care, and they’ve always been able to help fix whatever issue he’s having.

The front desk ladies are amazing — always kind, attentive, and they never keep me waiting long. You can tell everyone there genuinely cares about the animals and their owners.

Dr. Riera is incredible. She helped Rocky with his allergic skin condition and was able to find the right food for him, which made such a huge difference. Melany and Maura are also wonderful and always treat Rocky with patience, love, and care. Rocky is a very hyperactive dog and not always the easiest to control, but they handle him so lovingly every single time.

I would recommend this location with my eyes closed. Thank you all for always taking such great care of Rocky!

I have been coming to VCA for some years now and my pets have always received the best service and treatment. From the moment you walk in, you are treated like family. I have also noticed the cleanliness in the waiting area, hall ways, and separate room. The staff, technicians, and doctors, treat my pets as their own which makes me and my pets feel very comfortable and happy. You are attended quickly. I have taken my pets when they have experienced all sorts of illnesses and pains and they always recover quickly. I couldn’t recommend them enough!

I get you guys have to upsale Ima sales man too but you guys fear mongering your patients aint the way . I had to bite my tongue when the Doctor couldnt explain with all the tests and Xrays that the dog had a simple tummy ache and was taking a nap I asked if my puppy would come back from it and they said idk . I had them test my puppy german shepherd to parasites and they said the test wasnt 100% so what am I paying for is the question ?? The fact that you guys over exaggerate especially me not knowing how the insurance on a dog works these people just went on a field day . Indirect responses to all test no diagnosis at all and when you opt out they try to push you to get the treatment they tried to hospitalize my German shepherd puppy for a simple tummy ache . Before the person who responds to these reviews decides to dispute what I am saying understand that everything these people did was for an upsale and money and will act like they are doing it to insure the health of the patient and the best of the patient blah blah blah . Just letting you know I thought you might say this . The reality of it is going to this place was a blank mission . The only good person there is the young boy at the front desk he is going places . My late dog Nala had on operation where I paid 6,000 dollars to save her and now realize these people lacked the knowledge or skill to perform any type of surgery at all because she died inside this hospital and I thought they where doing the right thing these people made my dog a science project  . They are kids running a muck in an office and My dog was there experiment . You got me once shame on you , you got me twice shame on me there will not be a third time . My puppy is back to herself like any person or animal just needed rest after poop and vomiting from treats to a sensitive stomach . Has anyone hear had the runs before ?? Well its the same for dogs . Everything these people gave and prescribed was not needed at all but hey in the heat of the moment expect these people to Jerk the knife to make you move and do what they want . My animals will be your test subjects no more . Once again no straight forward diagnosis answer just I dont know’s and that is when I realized I was in the wrong place . If you cannot explain the a person that the dog has the runs after all the tests you ran and including Xrays fee’s that you have to pay to decipher what is going wrong in the dogs stomach then you are definitely in the wrong place . These people went from 1,600 - 2,000 and then 3,000 I had to be polite if not these people will try to shame you subliminally. The realization that I brought my previous dog here to be butchered on a surgical table was my punishment for not coming to realize sooner these people have no Idea what they are doing or saying .
Very nice people. 👍🏻

5 stars! My dog Rocky arrived intoxicated from medication, and the team acted immediately. Their quick response and professionalism truly made the difference. The staff was caring and attentive. I’m very grateful—highly recommend!

I brought my 15-year-old poodle to the emergency room at Knowles Animal Hospital - Snapper Creek on April 4, 2026, due to blood in her urine. Bloodwork and a urine test were performed, and I was told the urine results would be available on April 6. The total cost of this visit was approximately $1,000, which I found to be rather high.
What followed was a completely unacceptable experience. On April 6, I was told the results had arrived and that the doctor would call me. The very next day, I was told the results were not available. Over the next several days, I continued to follow up and was repeatedly given inconsistent and contradictory information.
On April 9, I was again told the results were not ready. I left a message for the doctor and never received a callback. On April 13, I was told they had tried to contact me on April 11, yet I had no missed calls or voicemail. Only then were the results finally reviewed with me, and I was told they would be sent to my veterinarian. My vet did not receive them until April 15.
It is unacceptable that after bringing a senior dog to the ER for a serious concern, it took 11 days to receive test results—especially after paying such a significant amount for emergency care. By that point, the information was outdated and of limited value. I was told antibiotics could be prescribed based on an 11-day-old sample, which I found irresponsible and declined. My veterinarian is now reevaluating her condition.
The lack of urgency, poor communication, and disorganization throughout this process were extremely disappointing. When it comes to emergency care—especially for senior pets—timely and reliable communication is critical, and this facility failed on both counts.
I do not recommend this facility to anyone who is concerned about their pet’s wellbeing.

The pinnacle of corporate greed! If you’re a long time resident of this area you probably remember this location as the premier pet care vet. Under VCA, no longer! They absolutely do not have any idea on how to treat, diagnose and manage pet health. Especially for CATS. On top of that, they are extremely heartless, apathetic and greedy. There’s something wrong when google searches provide better information. Avoid!

I made an appointment and then sat in the waiting room for 30 minutes before I left never being taken care of. They took two walk-ins ahead of me who did not have appointments and were not emergencies. One had a cat that she just wanted checked because he was a stray that had been hanging around her house and had been sneezing some blood but had no signs of distress and they even said that to her that he seems fine but that they’ll check him. The second walk-in had a what they thought was a bladder infection and they even tried to convince her to come back the following day so she wouldn’t have to pay the additional fee for not having an appointment and when she said she’d prefer to be seen today they took her ahead of me. When I asked why they kept taking these walk-ins ahead of me since I had an appointment they said oh we’re just putting them in a room and you’re just waiting for a technician. Well guess who goes in the room and asks each client what’s going on with their pet? It’s a technician so clearly these people are all being taken care of ahead of my dog that had an appointment. Absolute worst customer service you can imagine.

Terrible service. My appointment was at 3:40, it's 5:30 and they haven't even checked it. On top of that, they charged me for an exam that no doctor even saw. We had to leave because of the awful service.

A great place and very close to my home.

This veterinary place has: very friendly employees, they are respectful, they are knowledgeable, very helpful and most important straightforward.
What is also important to me is cleanliness and the usual pet odors.  This place is very clean and has ZERO off putting odors.  Yes, your dog will sniff around… Aren’t they all.

The exams are very thorough, even the Vet-Techs are all hands on, take very detailed notes, do take their time with you and suggesting good solutions.

The wait time, well it’s a 24hrs place, unless you have an appointment you will have to wait.  This is a popular place in Kendall.  Pet parents will understand, they want their best for their little babies.  Our furry friends...  This place is easy to get to, with ample parking spaces.

Emergencies have priority and, if there are more people already waiting, then you will spend some time there.  CALL AHEAD!  Make an appointment!  If you have an emergency please call.

There are also other VCA places around in fairly close proximity and, if “the shit really hits the fan” and your pet is super sick, or got hit by a car, god forbid, there is always VEG on Dixi Highway/Pincrest and one near the Design District.  They are also really good places for big emergencies.

The sitting area is very large, the exam rooms are a bit on the smaller side and clearly the small benches that are available to sit on barely hold two people; if.  They should invest in BETTER seating options in their rooms.

The bench at the front desk is ok.  A fridge with water is available.  Go on the VCA website and get your coupon for a free “first time” exam.  Saves you money.  The prices are as always a bit steep.  It starts at $95 for a basic exam and warm handshake.  $150 and change, without appointment.  It can only go up from there.  Better get yourself a good pet insurance.  MetLife is reasonable priced and pretty good.  Just to let you know…

Good luck!

Terrible experience!!! They don't respect other people's time!!!
I made an appointment for Saturday at 9:00 am through the link they sent me along with a text message reminding me about my dog's annual vaccination. When I arrived, they told me I didn't have an appointment and that to see her, I would have to pay for a walk-in, not an appointment, which was an extra $60. I made an appointment for today, Sunday, at 9:20 am, which I arrived for with plenty of time. Minutes after arriving, they took me to a consultation room to wait there with my dog. After about half an hour, they told me they had an emergency and needed the consultation room, so they moved me to a smaller one. At that point, I asked how much longer we would have to wait to be seen. After half an hour, and with no one approaching to tell me how much longer we would have to wait, I decided to leave without being seen. When I went to complain at the front desk, they still didn't know how much longer we would have to wait. Unacceptable!!! And if you have to go, I recommend you go with plenty of time because you never know when they'll attend to you.
For my part, I will never return to this place.
Best Vet care, Dr Riera is the best, very attentive and compassionate with my best friend!🐾❤️🐾 …
Amazing experience and very happy with the service provided by the staff and Doctor Riera she’s phenomenal, I highly recommend her and the place for your pet !!!
Anais, thank you for taking the time to share this feedback! 💙 🐾 …
Have no complaints. Friendly technicians. Clean place and the doctor very patience and willing to explain while examining my dog.

Today I went with my princesita because she has been getting worse. It was time for her to be in peace. I had never been to this clinic and a friend recommended it. They were so understanding and gentle to make the process of euthanasia less painful. I am so thankful to the staff and doctor that help me in this moment. The pics are before and after the process
Amazing!
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We love caring for your furry family members. We appreciate the trust you place in our team here at VCA!
Doctor was very helpful and attentive made sure to update me on anything that happened post surgery. The overall experience was patient and very understanding during a stressful situation.

When our cat Chester suddenly stopped eating after the loss of our older cat, we feared he was grieving. But within just a few days, he became jaundiced and dropped 5 pounds. We rushed him to an emergency vet who quoted us $6,000 before even diagnosing the issue. Feeling overwhelmed and unsure, we left and brought Chester to VCA Knowles — and I’m so glad we did.

From the moment we arrived, the team at VCA Knowles treated Chester with compassion and urgency. They kept us informed every step of the way and quickly discovered he had ingested plastic, which had severely impacted his liver. It was a terrifying situation, but their care and transparency gave us hope.

Chester is still in their care, and we’re praying for his recovery. While it’s been a costly ordeal, it’s nowhere near the initial quote we received elsewhere — and the quality of care has been exceptional. I’m incredibly grateful to the staff at VCA Knowles for their dedication and kindness during such a difficult time. Dr. Perez & Dr. Riviera were both very empathetic and great.

I am praying for his recovery, he means so much to me and he is only 6 years old.

Updated 12/23/25 - Chester is doing amazing thanks to the staff and Vets at Knowles. He is doing so well that he is Mr. February in "Paw Prints" 2026 Calander.  I have added the pics for everyone to see. My Chester is Back to his Handsome loving self.
Thank you, Knowles

Dr Perez is nothing but amazing and helpful. My puppy Reese got neutered with her and some things came up but she was there and helped with everything. He’s currently in their care and she never fails to call me and update me everyday about him. I usually hate when he’s away from me and I get the worst anxiety but they make me feel and know he’s safe! Also the technicians are incredible. I don’t remember her name but she has curly hair. She’s a sweetheart! Some staff were kind of rude but everybody else was amazing!

Thank you Dr Perez!!

This is the greatest place for my fur babies. I have been taking my animals here for decades. There's never been guessing evaluations or hidden fees. Recently my 3 yr old boy went in with a high level infection which needed immediate surgery. Not only was the staff concious of the complicity of this case, Dr Marina Riera arrived early for her shift just to attend my boy. Constant reassuring and confident of procedure she would perform. My boy recieved gentle care from all staff members, technicians showed love and support for both him and I. Recovery was at its best at the facility, post op instructions clear, follow up visits and phone calls as if he was one of their own. I have always trusted this hospital but the amazing treatment given to Charlie was exquisite.. there is not enough stars for this amazing hospital. Thank you to all who were involved and may you continue to do what you do best which is caring for all the souls who enter your doors. ❤️

This was our second time visiting Knowles Snapper Creek and it didn't disappoint.  I feel they are compassionate, patient and thorough.  I love the Vet, Dr. Betancourt as he takes his time with us and explains everything carefully, easy to understand.  Everyone--from the Receptionist to the Techs. are super nice!  I highly recommend them!

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the entire staff at VCA Knowles Snapper Animal Hospital for saving our beloved dog Tommy’s life. He swallowed a nickel, and we went through one of the scariest moments we’ve ever faced. From the very first moment, everyone was incredibly attentive, kind, and professional.

A very special thank you to Dr. Marina Riera, who was beyond honest, compassionate, and truly vocational in every step of the process. Words are not enough to describe our appreciation. For those of us who love our pets, we know how heartbreaking and stressful situations like this can be, but this amazing team gave us hope and peace of mind.

Today, after so much fear and uncertainty, Tommy is back to eating, playing, and being his happy self again. ❤️ Thank you, Dr. Marina, and thank you to the entire VCA Knowles Snapper team. We will always come back here, and we hope our story inspires others to trust this wonderful hospital and its outstanding staff. 🫂

i don’t usually do reviews but Dr. Riera is amazing. She also speaks Spanish, have knowledge and experience. Almost a year ago she help to save my girls life after having pyometria. My girl has a very unique condition in her immune system which makes everything complicated but Dr. Riera knew how to handle it. Honestly me and my girls were happy to find her.

It is disappointing to give a 1 star review
since I have had many positive experiences with my pet with most VCA staff and doctors but unfortunately, every experience with Dr. D. Perez has been negative from missed medical issues to complete lack of regard or consideration for patients.  She is typically rude, uncaring and worst and most often wrong with her advice.   VCA overall has many positive qualities but this doctor really needs supervision.  Most of the techs seem much more knowledgeable and capable.   I always have to get a second opinion often from another VCA location which frequently contradicts her opinions.  Her response when confronted with any error or omission or even questions is that nothing is her problem and to call the office manager to complain.  I don’t think it is the office manager’s problem that Perez is difficult and has a bad attitude.  Office manager has always been excellent with helping correct her errors. Otherwise, prices are reasonable and very transparent with invoicing.

I am grateful for Dr. Perez and Dr. Zepeda for coming up with a great plan for my Lenny. Both were thorough and detailed and also very kind and understanding. My Lenny is back home from his surgery and in high spirits. Thank you to the team who cared for him as well and for being patient with him while he was scared and in pain. Definitely bring your pet here if there’s ever an emergency.

OUR FUR PUPPY FEELS SO MUCH BETTER!! IN ONE DAY! Ear infection that plagued him for over 2 months - doesn’t seem to be bothering him so much - Thank you Mayte (i hope i spelled it correctly) even though i’ve been there prior she took the time to throughly check out his history - so well educated i thought she was the Dr.! and then Dr Santos- Expertly handled our boy and administered all vaccines, treatments and treats as well as caresses and understanding pats. Went over all costs and options yes i left there broke but  later on in the day I noticed such an improvement in our boys health! And he was looking and feeling better! Thank you VCA for the excellent staff and care. The front desk and check out are all top notch!
Thank you so much for your review, Luis! We’d love to hear more about your experience, your feedback means a lot to us!
Rosie and Dr Riera are excellent! So sweet, gentle and caring!
They were so kind and patient with us and provided wonderful care of my Kiara.

So unprofessional and business that only thrive in collecting money and not making sure that pet health is first priority Took my pet there on Sunday and the way how we was handle down from front desk to office manager I will patiently  wait for they day to come to be on my end vca Knowles needs to ensure there staffing there business with employees that ensure and puts customer satisfaction first

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the team at Knowles Animal Hospital. On the worst day of my life 7/11/25, when I had to say goodbye to my beloved dog, their compassion and care meant everything to me.

The biggest issue I had is that I brought my senior cat in and they prescribed her the wrong diet, which could have led to longterm health issues including muscle wasting and the weakening of her immunity system. On her panel the vet did, my cat was on the higher end of normal for her kidney levels-signifying a slight decline. The doctor prescribed her a renal diet (kidney care) by Hills Science. I feel it’s important to list the brand because they have a sponsorship deal with them. My cat suffered with severe constipation. I never would have thought that the food would be wrong. After asking other veterinarian professionals, I realized the food was not prescribed correctly as this diet is for cats with *advanced kidney disease* or advanced kidney issues. If I had kept her on it, she would have longterm effects.

It’s frustrating because I take my cat’s health so seriously and this could have been so detrimental to her. It felt careless.

The vet even talked about treatment for her kidneys. It’s possible he was trying to preemptively address any issues, but this was over all a negligent prescription.

Another issue is a Miami issue - the front desk girls were rude. I walked in holding my cat in my arms, they asked me what I wanted, I told them I had an appointment for my cat. They blankly stared at me. I politely told them “and this is my cat.” Then they started asking me questions. It’s such a frustrating experience to have. Walking into a vet where it feels like the front desk staff doesn’t really care and are also mildly bothered.

Because of the reasons above, I will never be going back. I will travel out of town for any pet issues. I’ve always had issues in Miami for anything healthcare or vet related.
If you are needing fast and friendly help for your pup, this is the place to go. Dr. Betancourt is great, so is the staff! Thanks guys!

As far as I could see, the place was clean, but completely unprofessional. I arrived with my dog ​​in my arms; she was giving birth and even had the baby's feet out, but she couldn't deliver. They told me it was obvious she was pregnant because her mammary glands were swollen, but they couldn't see a baby on the ultrasound. We were alarmed, insisting that they could see one, but that it was stuck. Then they said they saw one facing away from the mother and another in the birth canal, but they couldn't hear a heartbeat. They said they needed x-rays to be sure, and then they said they would perform a C-section and a hysterectomy because it was the clinic's policy, and that the cost would be something like 4,600. We were alarmed, picked up our dog, and left. At another clinic, she was seen for less than half the price, which included the operation, an overnight stay, and all the medications. To my surprise, the dog only had one puppy that was stuck because it was too big. So, in my opinion, those who are... I don't know if the guards there even studied mechanics, because with the stories they tried to tell me, they don't seem like veterinarians. It's a shame they make a business out of the life of a little animal that's part of the family. I don't recommend them at all. I'm more disappointed than annoyed.

Hello, I took my dog ​​to the vet because she was having trouble breathing. Even though she was breathing like that in the morning, she went out to the yard and sat in the sun like she does every day. Then she went back inside without any problem. I decided to take her so I wouldn't be negligent, but it was the worst experience of my life. They gave me an initial estimate of $1200, which included an X-ray and blood work. I told them to just take the X-ray, so the bill would be $690. Then they charged me $80 for the radiologist to look at the X-ray in an hour. Then they gave me another estimate saying they wanted to keep her for 24 hours, which was a total of $2780, or they had another option which was to keep her until the evening for $1700. I told them I couldn't pay that. Then they told me she wasn't well and asked what I wanted to do. I told them I would take her home. Since she had fluid around her heart, they told me they were going to do a heart transplant, give her a diuretic, and something else. They tried to calm her down, but when they handed her back to me she was almost dead—well, she literally died two blocks away. The visit cost $980, and my dog ​​was dying. If you don't want to lose your pets and your money, look for other options.
